integrity: The proof is self-contained for arbitrary finite projective planes for the 14-cell result and for all prime fields for the landmark threshold; exact checks over six small primes are corroborative and not infinite certification.
limitations: Four point-landmark sufficiency is proven only for Desarguesian planes over prime fields. Three-mark class profile requires three noncollinear points and sorted point/line vertices. Self-review is not independent validation.
title: Three marked points leave fourteen refinement cells; four resolve prime projective planes
